title: How a Godly Man Handles Being Praised the Same Way He Handles Being Ignored
caption:
A godly man's face doesn't change when the praise stops.

Watch him when no one's clapping. That's the real man.

Notice what you do the second the compliment lands. Do the same job the day nobody mentions it. Let being overlooked cost you nothing.

Whatever you do, work at it as for the Lord and not for men, knowing that from the Lord you will receive the inheritance as your reward (Colossians 3:23-24). He saw the version nobody clapped for. That's the version that counts.
